correctness.rationale: Non-atomic biased binary self-similar law meets published convex-image theorem for both globally C2 strictly convex maps, and for their dyadic-cylinder compositions. Function-independent Fourier exponent yields uniform local sigma. Strong law plus all-base normality from Fourier decay gives exact simultaneous digit frequencies. Plancherel with 2k sigma>1 gives absolutely continuous sum convolution, and Steinhaus gives interval in the difference set. Biased frequency class is null; Lipschitz quadratic image is null. Hypotheses and quantifiers checked with full primary theorem.

value.rationale: Arithmetic regularity of counterexamples to digit-tail invariance is a motivated question. The theorem finds Lebesgue-null failures even among absolutely normal paired arguments with locally power-Fourier-decaying input measures and uniform finite additive thickness. Such size properties do not follow from full Hausdorff dimension and constitute a substantive structural strengthening, not a constant or ad hoc computation.
